subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '5'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f07673cee47839c493990b15db0638f5a29f1f394f82e615ceaa6465bd12843b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24b369d78117198e81a45c8ebeb9c16fba85284a204078626912c347eded6a9a.png]
solution:
From the given figure we can see:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f07673cee47839c493990b15db0638f5a29f1f394f82e615ceaa6465bd12843b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24b369d78117198e81a45c8ebeb9c16fba85284a204078626912c347eded6a9a.png] 

In a dice, a face is surrounded by four sides and the remaining side is opposite it.

 
• We can see all four sides around the face '5' which are 1, 2, 3, and 4.
 
• The remaining face is '6' which means 6 and 5 are opposite faces.

So the face opposite 5 is 6.

Hence the correct answer is 6.
